2025_081_tsd_administration_building_cat.paragraph: Quote 1460.001 from ISCG (Interior Systems Contract Group Inc.), 612 N. Main St., Royal Oak, MI 48067, printed Sep 25, 2025, proposes Category A furniture, seating and systems workstations for the Troy School District administration building at 4400 Livernois, Troy, MI 48098. Pricing is taken from State of Michigan MiDEAL seating contract #240000000497 and open office contract #22000000043, and covers numbered line items 0 through 254 spanning individual offices, conference rooms, workrooms and collaboration areas. The subtotal is 238,597.99 with Total Tax of 0.00 and a Total Amount of USD 238,597.99; the Deposit Required is 95,439.20 under terms of 50% deposit, balance net 30.
2025_081_tsd_administration_building_cat.page:
**Document type**
Vendor quotation (Quote 1460.001, Project 1460) issued by ISCG / Interior Systems Contract Group Inc., 612 N. Main St., Royal Oak, MI 48067, phone (248)399-1600, fax (248)399-1601, www.iscginc.com. Date Printed: Sep 25, 2025. Presented to the Troy Board of Education as the Category A furniture proposal for the district administration building.

**Parties**
Sold To, Bill To and Install Location are all customer number 10934-00, TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, 4400 LIVERNOIS, TROY, MI 48098 US; Bill To is attention Accounts Payable. The header block lists reference TROY SCHOOLS ADMIN, sales person NIVES KAJTAZOVIC, and terms 50% DEPOSIT, BALANCE NET 30.

**Contract vehicle**
Comment lines at the head of the quote cite STATE OF MICHIGAN MIDEAL, the SEATING CONTRACT #240000000497 and the OPEN OFFICE CONTRACT #22000000043. A leading note states that ISCG will hold pricing for 90 days on the quote provided there is not a manufacturer price increase and/or surcharges and tariffs applied, in which case ISCG has the right to provide updated pricing. A footer adds: PRICING SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY TIME DUE TO TARIFFS.

The quote states it expires on September 25, 2025, and provides signature, date, print name and title lines for the Buyer.

Both labor lines carry the note NORMAL BUSINESS HOURS. NON-UNION LABOR and Tag 1:P8719.

**Scope by location tag**
Line items are tagged to rooms and zones including 102, 120, 121, 137, 138, 143, 154, COR C1, CR 103, CR 119, CR 136, CR 146, OFFICES, WRK 131, WRK 139_145, WRK 145, OFF_WRK, PM and SURCHARGE. Product families quoted include Haworth Compose panel systems, X Series storage and pedestals, Upside and Upside+ height-adjustable bases and tops, Planes and Jive tables, Masters Series casegoods, Cabana lounge seating, Zody LX and Zody Guest chairs, Soji task chairs, Maari side/conference/bar-height seating, Breck stools, Immerse tables and enhanced power modules. Finishes recur as River Cherry laminate, Metallic Silver, Chrome, Smoke, Patterned Linen Classic, Pixel/Dice and Soji Knit Carbon.

**Terms and conditions**
Twenty numbered conditions follow the pricing, covering non-binding status until signed and accepted, credit review, non-cancelable and non-returnable product, buyer responsibility for tariffs and sales/use taxes imposed after order placement, NET 30 payment, 30 days of free warehousing, storage charges for construction delays, non-union labor during normal business hours, interest at the higher of 18% per annum or the maximum rate permitted by law on past due amounts, an ISCG security interest with authority to file a UCC-1, assignment of manufacturer warranties, American Arbitration Association dispute resolution, attorney fees, and a 2.0% fee on VISA, MasterCard or American Express payments above $2,000.

TERMS AND CONDITIONS. Twenty numbered conditions close the document. The proposal is not binding unless signed by an authorized representative of the Buyer and accepted by an ISCG Manager. ISCG may request financial information and modify terms, including the deposit requirement. Product purchased is not cancelable or returnable. All imposed tariffs assessed after order placement and applicable sales and use taxes are added at invoicing and are the Buyer's responsibility. NET 30 payment terms apply; if the Buyer cannot accept delivery, ISCG will warehouse product for 30 days at no charge, after which reasonable storage charges apply, and products stored due to construction delays beyond 30 days are considered accepted for invoicing. Partial deliveries are invoiced as delivered. Delivery and installation occur during normal business hours with non-union labor, with the Buyer paying for overtime or union labor it requests. Interest is charged at the higher of 18% per annum or the maximum rate permitted by law on past due amounts. ISCG retains a security interest until full payment and may file a UCC-1. ISCG is not responsible for a manufacturer's inability to meet estimated ship dates and no price reduction is due for manufacturer delay. The Buyer must provide a free and clear job site, elevator service and offloading facilities at no charge, and secure all necessary building permits. The Buyer bears risk of loss after delivery and must carry fire and extended coverage insurance with loss payable to ISCG. Manufacturer warranties are assigned to the Buyer with no other warranties provided. Disputes are settled under the Rules of the American Arbitration Association, and the Buyer pays ISCG's attorney fees and enforcement costs. Use of VISA, MasterCard or American Express for deposits or invoice payments above $2,000 is assessed an additional fee equal to 2.0% of the amount charged. The proposal and terms constitute the entire agreement and may not be changed without ISCG Management's written authorization.
